ruleName: Ball Played as It Lies; Ball at Rest Lifted or Moved
title: Ball in a Fairway Divot: Free Relief?
question: Your tee shot finishes in the middle of the fairway, but unfortunately the ball comes to rest in a deep divot left by another player. Can you take free relief?

choices.text: Yes. A divot is ground under repair.
Yes. You are entitled to relief because your ball is on the fairway.
No. You must play the ball as it lies unless a Local Rule says otherwise.
Yes, but only if the divot has not yet started to grow back.

explanation: A common misconception is that free relief is allowed from a divot in the fairway. Under the Rules of Golf, however, a divot is not ground under repair and there is no automatic entitlement to free relief. The ball must be played as it lies unless a Local Rule gives additional options.
